Company description: HD (Generated via gemini-3.5-flash-lite)

The Home Depot, Inc., traded under the stock ticker HD, is the world's largest home improvement specialty retailer. The company operates a chain of big-box stores supplying a vast assortment of building materials, hardware, home improvement supplies, appliances, and lawn and garden products. It caters to both do-it-yourself consumers and professional contractors, complemented by a robust digital retail platform and extensive tool rental services. Founded in 1978 in Atlanta, Georgia, by Bernie Marcus, Arthur Blank, Ron Brill, and Pat Farrah, the company revolutionized the home improvement industry through its warehouse-store concept. Since opening its first two stores in Georgia, The Home Depot has expanded rapidly across North America, evolving into a Fortune 500 company and a staple of the retail sector.
